Session/access lifetime is 15 minutes bounded by a fixed 720-hour absolute session expiry, and the refresh expires at the same absolute boundary. The old access token becomes stale because current_access_token_hash changes. Concurrent same-token refreshes therefore produce one winner and one replay revocation, intentionally invalidating the family after detected reuse.
